responsibility: This file implements the default language hook behaviors used by front ends that do not need specialized handling for particular integration points. It supplies baseline routines for option postprocessing, assembler-name assignment, aliasing, incomplete-type diagnostics, declaration naming, builtin and builtin-type registration, generic LTO section emission, early debug finalization, and other frontend services, plus helper predicates that identify the active GNU language family from lang_hooks.name. These routines form the executable defaults referenced by langhooks-def.h.
same_name_distinction: Implements default language-hook behavior and helper routines referenced by frontend hook tables, such as builtin registration, assembler-name assignment, LTO section handling, and language-family predicates, whereas gcc/langhooks.h defines the lang_hooks structure and hook signatures that front ends must populate.
